artworks.title: Jean-Baptiste Rousseau
artworks.dimensions: sheet: 53 × 36.5 cm (20 7/8 × 14 3/8 in.), trimmed within platemark
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Stephen and Claudine Ostrow in honor of Esme
artworks.description: The image portrays a man in a three-quarter length portrait. He is seated, looking ahead. The man has a broad face with full cheeks, a prominent nose, and deep-set eyes. He has curly, medium-length light-colored hair. He is dressed in an elaborate 18th-century outfit with a buttoned vest, a long coat with voluminous sleeves, and ruffled cuffs. He holds a quill pen in his left hand and rests his right arm on a table with papers and books. The background is a plain wall with a molding pattern.

artworks.title: Dancers and Performers  (Page from a Sketchbook)
artworks.description: The image shows a series of curved and intersecting lines forming loose and flowing shapes across the page. In the lower region, there are bold, wavy lines, while above these, finer lines weave in multiple directions.

artworks.title: Dancers and Performers (Page from a Sketchbook)
artworks.description: The image shows curved and angular lines on a plain background. The lines create loose, freeform shapes that may resemble waves or an uncoiled slinky. Some straight lines intersect at angles, suggesting geometric shapes like a ladder or a kite. The composition is minimalistic, evoking subconscious doodles.

artworks.title: Dancers and Performers (Page from a Sketchbook)
artworks.description: The image shows various meandering lines and loosely sketched shapes arranged in an abstract composition. These elements convey a sense of motion and fluidity. An oval shape is located towards the top, with a cluster of lines below. Near the bottom, there is a circular form with leaf-like extensions.

artworks.title: Dancers and Performers (Page from a Sketchbook)
artworks.description: The image displays various overlapping lines and curves drawn lightly in pencil on the paper, forming an abstract composition. The lines create a pattern that loosely resembles the outline of birds or scattered leaves. The abstract sketch allows for individual interpretation as viewers may see different shapes or movements in the drawing.

artworks.title: Dancers and Performers (Page from a Sketchbook)
artworks.description: The drawing depicts an abstract composition of curved and angular lines converging in different directions on the page. Some lines form loop-like shapes that may resemble a bird in flight, while other parts suggest outlines of wings or feathers.

artworks.title: Dancers and Performers (Page from a Sketchbook)
artworks.description: The image shows a series of curving and meandering lines intersecting and forming flowing arcs on a plain background.

artworks.title: Dancers and Performers (Page from a Sketchbook)
artworks.description: The image features curved and angular lines scattered randomly across the page, creating an abstract composition. The lines vary in thickness and loop and intersect. The drawing may evoke stylized leaves or wings in motion. The pencil marks on the plain background give the impression of a spontaneous and freeform sketch.

artworks.title: Dancers and Performers (Page from a Sketchbook)
artworks.description: Lines sketched on a plain background form an abstract composition that resembles a bird in flight with extended wings or a person with outstretched arms. The central shape curves downward, with lines extending outward, suggesting movement and freedom.

artworks.title: A Gentleman Pilgrim with a Rosary
artworks.artist: Marco Alvise Pitteri after Giovanni Battista Piazzetta
artworks.medium: engraving with etching on laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows the upper half of a person's body in a seated position. The individual has prominent facial features and long hair. They are wearing a light-colored shirt with a ruffled collar under a dark outer garment. The person's hand is raised to their chest, displaying rings on their fingers. The background is a dark, plain surface.

artworks.title: The Smith Family
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Charles Isaacs and Carol Nigro
artworks.description: The image contains six old-fashioned photographs displayed in a wooden frame with gold detailing. Each photograph is framed with a soft golden border and placed in one of the six rectangular slots within the frame. The photographs feature pairs of people in portrait style from the waist up. The top row shows a man with a young girl, a mother holding a baby with a boy, and an older couple. The bottom row shows two men, two women, and two young girls. The background in all photographs is a plain studio setting.

artworks.title: Watkins Glen Scenery, Spiral Gorge
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Charles Isaacs and Carol Nigro
artworks.description: The image shows a narrow canyon with steep rock walls, a stream flowing through the rocky bed, layered rock formations, and a path with a wooden railing. The canyon walls frame the scene, giving a sense of enclosure. The rocks display erosion patterns and textures, and the color palette is sepia. The canyon stretches into the distance with the path running alongside it.

artworks.title: Watkins Glen Scenery, Rainbow Falls and Triple Cascades
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Charles Isaacs and Carol Nigro
artworks.description: The image presents Watkins Glen, featuring cascading waterfalls and steep rock walls. The viewer sees a gorge with a waterfall on the left, flowing over a rounded rock formation. The scene is enclosed by towering rocks. A wooden bridge or pathway crosses the waterfall's path. The color palette is sepia-toned, giving the image a vintage appearance. The rocky surfaces show intricate detail, emphasizing their textures and layers. The flowing water is captured with a smooth, blurred technique, conveying movement and continuity.

artworks.title: Watkins Glen Scenery, Shadow Gorge
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Charles Isaacs and Carol Nigro
artworks.description: The image shows a stereoscopic view of a narrow gorge with rugged rock formations on either side, a winding creek in the center, and a wooden bridge in the distance. Several small figures are on the bridge, and the horizon is obscured by foliage and trees. The scene is in a sepia tone, highlighting the textures of the rocks and water reflections. The composition is balanced with the gorge's lines leading towards the bridge.

artworks.title: "Saratoga Springs and Vicinity"
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Charles Isaacs and Carol Nigro
artworks.description: This is a photograph of a rock formation with water on top and a glass placed on its surface. The image is presented in a stereoscopic format with two almost identical images side by side. The rock formation appears rugged and textured, with a distinctive basin-like shape at the top filled with liquid. There is a glass resting at the center of this basin. The setting seems to be an enclosed area, potentially suggesting that this is a well-known or preserved natural feature. The card surrounding the photograph is labeled with ornate typography, indicating its context as "High Rock Spring" from Saratoga Springs.

artworks.title: "Mt. Kearsarge and Double Head, from Mt. Washington"
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Charles Isaacs and Carol Nigro
artworks.description: The image shows a stereoscopic view from the summit of Mount Washington. The viewer's perspective is slightly elevated, looking out over a rugged landscape of rocks and wooden planks that lead the eye towards a series of mountain ranges extending into the distance. The horizon sits fairly high in the image, marked by a line where the peaks meet the overcast sky. The style of the photograph is straightforward, with a soft focus on the distant mountains, giving a hazy effect typical of early photographic techniques. The overall color palette is monochromatic, with shades of gray and sepia giving the scene a muted and timeless quality. The clouds above add texture to the sky, providing contrast to the solid, dark forms of the mountains below.

artworks.title: Veduta della facciata di dietro della Basilica di S. Maria Maggiore
artworks.description: The image shows a detailed view of Basilica di S. Maria Maggiore from a slightly elevated point of view. The horizon line is low, with a sky filled with clouds. An obelisk is on the left side. The image features meticulous engravings capturing the architecture. The color palette is monochromatic, with figures around the structure.

artworks.title: Campagna di Roma (Roman Countryside) (recto)
artworks.medium: graphite with white heightening on brown paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Christopher and Beverly With in memory of Karl and Gerda With
artworks.description: The image shows a landscape with rocky terrain viewed from a slightly elevated angle. Large rocks with rough textures dominate the left side, some vegetation trailing over their edges. The horizon is high in the drawing with distant hills and a faint shoreline. A fence runs horizontally from left to right, guiding the eye to a path disappearing into the distance. The style uses loose brushstrokes with fine lines and shading. The color palette is monochromatic with sepia-toned paper, utilizing white and black pencil or charcoal for detailing. A small sailboat is visible in the distance, enhancing the sense of depth.

artworks.title: View from Fishkill Looking to West Point
artworks.artist: John Hill after William Guy Wall
artworks.medium: hand-colored engraving and aquatint on wove paper
artworks.description: The image shows a panoramic landscape from Fishkill looking towards West Point. The viewpoint is elevated, offering a wide view of the terrain. The horizon is prominently displayed high in the image, showing hills and sky meeting. The hills gently slope towards the horizon. The painting technique features detailed brushstrokes blending shades smoothly. The color scheme consists of soft earth tones, light blue for water and sky, and green hues. In the foreground, there are rocks, grass patches, and trees. Moving further, water bodies with islands and a few buildings can be seen. Larger hills appear in the distance, with sunlight peeking through the clouds casting rays on the scene.

artworks.title: The "Internationalists" Are to Make the World All One Millennium - (Chaos)
artworks.medium: wood engraving in black on newsprint
artworks.description: The image features an array of jagged lines and sparkling points of light forming an abstract network. The largest shape resembles a skull, with dark clouds swirling behind it. A crescent moon is partially obscured by clouds in the upper left corner.

artworks.title: Why He Cannot Sleep
artworks.medium: wood engraving in black on newsprint

artworks.title: The Watch on Spoilers. The Democratic Tigers and Republian Vultures Must Be Kept at Bay.
artworks.medium: wood engraving in black on newsprint
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a woman with a sword, a large cat, and a vulture. The woman is viewed from behind, holding a sheathed sword. To her left is a large cat, and to her right is a vulture perched on a rocky outcrop. The title of the drawing is "The Watch on Spoilers." The image is from the front page of "Harper's Weekly" from August 7, 1886, with a tagline that reads, "Democratic Tigers and Republican Vultures must be kept at bay."

artworks.title: Arlington Heights. Die Wacht. Am Potomac.
artworks.medium: wood engraving in black on newsprint
artworks.description: The image depicts a soldier standing near an engraved stone that reads "DIED FOR THE UNION." The scene includes trees, a low horizon with a setting or rising sun casting a glow on calm waters, and the soldier holding a rifle. The color palette is gray, with shades to create depth and emphasize the moonlit background. Engravings of "ARLINGTON HEIGHTS" and "DIE WACHT AM POTOMAC" frame the composition.

artworks.title: On the Red Danube - "Bless You, My Children!"
artworks.medium: wood engraving in black on newsprint, two-page centerfold
